record.original_question: If X is a T0 space and Y is a strong d-space, is the function space Top0(X,Y) with the pointwise convergence topology also a strong d-space?

evidence.quote: Question 8.11. Let X be a T0 space and Y a strong d-space. Is the function space Top0(X, Y ) equipped with the pointwise convergence topology a strong d-space? (cf. Proposition 2.2)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a T_0 topological space Z, let ≤_Z denote the specialization preorder, defined by x ≤_Z y iff x ∈ cl_Z({y}). A subset D ⊆ Z is directed if it is nonempty and every two elements of D have an upper bound in D with respect to ≤_Z. The space Z is called a d-space (or monotone convergence space) if every directed subset D of Z has a supremum sup D in (Z, ≤_Z) and D converges to sup D in the topology of Z (equivalently, cl_Z(D) = ↓ sup D where ↓ denotes downset under ≤_Z). 

A T_0 space Z is called a strong d-space if for every directed subset D of Z and every open set U of Z with the property that every upper bound of D in (Z, ≤_Z) lies in U, one has D ∩ U ≠ ∅.

Given two T_0 spaces X and Y, let Top_0(X, Y) denote the set of all continuous maps from X to Y. Equip Top_0(X, Y) with the topology of pointwise convergence, i.e., the subspace topology inherited from the product space Y^X.

Question: If X is an arbitrary T_0 space and Y is a strong d-space, must Top_0(X, Y) (with the topology of pointwise convergence) be a strong d-space?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published resolution of this specific question about whether the pointwise-convergence function space Top_0(X,Y) inherits the strong d-space property from Y. Related work on strong d-spaces, well-filtered spaces, and d*-spaces has appeared, but no source explicitly confirms or refutes this question, so its current status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: The d*-space
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses strong d-spaces and related properties of T_0 spaces, but does not resolve the function space question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on d*-spaces and strong d-spaces does not record a resolution to whether Top_0(X,Y) with pointwise convergence is a strong d-space when Y is.
